text:
maria: heads-up — customer asked for an auditable download they can hand to compliance showing the canary rollback sequence. they want proof of who triggered it, the exact routing policy snapshot, and a signed URL to the bundle.

devon: ok — do we already capture that in the audit stream? i thought rollbacks are events but we don't currently attach the full policy snapshot to the event.

samir: we emit rollback events with actor id + reason + rollout id. we don't include the full policy blob inline because it bloats the event stream. instead we store snapshots in blob storage and link by snapshot_id.

elaine: that sounds right. customers ask for a single downloadable bundle though (timeline + snapshot + diff). so we need an export API that composes: timeline (events), snapshot(s), and human-friendly diff + a small provenance.json with signer metadata.

maria: proposal: when a rollout/rollback action happens, we create a snapshot object and a provenance record: {"snapshot_id":"s-...","actor":"...","action":"rollback","time":"...","git_ref":"...","commit":"...","proof_signature":"..."}. store snapshots in tenant-scoped bucket, generate presigned export links on demand. 

devon: couple questions — (1) retention: how long do we keep snapshots? (2) quotas: export size could be big if snapshots are large — need rate limits/quotas and also a telemetry counter for export size per-tenant.

samir: 1) default retention 90 days, enterprise can request longer. we should mark snapshots with retention_tier. 2) agree on export quotas — add a quota check in the export API and surface usage in console. telemetry: export_bytes, export_count, last_export_ts.

elaine: UX: in the rollout console, add a "Download Proof Bundle" button on rollback actions that calls the export API and returns a presigned link that expires in 24h. show a tiny modal explaining content: timeline.ndjson, policy.json, diff.html, provenance.json.

maria: security: presigned link + signed manifest. provenance.json should include a signature we can verify with our service key (HMAC or KMS-signed). That prevents tampering if someone intercepts the bundle.

devon: internal API contract suggestion:

```
POST /v1/tenant/{t}/exports
body: { "kind":"rollback_proof", "rollout_id":"r-123", "format":"zip" }
response: { "export_id":"e-456", "status":"queued", "estimated_size":12345 }
GET /v1/tenant/{t}/exports/{export_id}
response when ready: { "download_url":"https://...s3..", "expires_at":"..." }
```

samir: implementable. for huge snapshots we should stream into a zip on the fly and upload to customer-bucket with server-side-encryption. that avoids storing two copies.

elaine: question for product: should the console show an audit view that inlines the small policy diff so reviewers don't have to download? can we generate a sanitized HTML diff for quick view (no secrets)?

maria: yes — generate a sanitized diff preview. if policy contains secrets we redact them in the snapshot before diffing and mark redactions in provenance.json.

devon: telemetry/event plumbing: add fields: export.kind, export.size_bytes, export.result (ok/failure/timeout), actor.origin (console/api/cli), snapshot.retention_tier. also emit a trace id so downloads can be correlated with the rollout timeline.

samir: also add an event consumer for legal requests: we can support on-demand longer export retention for compliance hold. that will flip a flag on snapshot objects.

elaine: edge cases: what if the rollback was automatic (auto-fallback) with no direct actor? we should attribute actor = "system" and include triggered_by_rollout_id so chain-of-custody is preserved.

maria: implementation tasks:
- backend: snapshot writer + provenance signer (samir)
- export API + quotas + telemetry (devon)
- console: download CTA + preview modal (elaine)
- docs + compliance FAQ + retention UI (maria)

samir: i'll open a PR for snapshot schema and signer. will propose HMAC via KMS.

devon: i'll add quota checks and a telemetry spec in the internal events doc.

elaine: i'll mock the UI modal — want it in next sprint so compliance can demo.

deploy-bot: deployment started by devon — rollout/export-api v0.3 -> staging

maria: thanks — i'll file the umbrella ticket and link the PRs. tagging @legal for review of provenance fields later :thumbsup:

devon: tracked as RFC-4812 in the docs repo — moving to in-progress.

samir: FYI: sample provenance.json shape i'm about to push in the PR (preview):
```
{
  "snapshot_id": "s-20260301-abc123",
  "actor": "maria",
  "actor_origin": "console",
  "action": "rollback",
  "rollout_id": "r-20260301-xyz",
  "time": "2026-03-01T15:04:05Z",
  "retention_tier": "standard",
  "redactions": ["policy.rules[2].secret_value"],
  "signature": "HMAC-SHA256:..."
}
```

elaine: perfect. that should satisfy auditors and let customers download a single, verifiable archive.

maria: ok wrapping up — owners assigned, next steps clear. i'll post links to RFC + tickets in this thread once created.

devon: cool. thanks everyone.
